purpose: Exact controlled-synthetic mechanism and identifiability check; not training or real CV evidence
sampling: Enumerate all four (Y,N) support states with exact rational weights. Draw N once per unit and preserve it in every environment. No random sampling.

readouts.h_color: sign(left red minus right red); a zero margin predicts +1
readouts.h_blue: sign(left blue minus right blue); a zero margin predicts +1

controls: Same signals without truncation: mathematical control, not recovery of an already clipped image
Same construction with both gains fixed to 6/5
success_or_falsification: Exact assertions must confirm or refute the prespecified identities, threshold, risks and counterexample. Any mismatch is reported; no parameter search follows.
limits: Two synthetic RGB patches and two fixed readouts, not trained AA/RA/TA policies
No photographs, final holdout, training, model download, GPU, new dependency, scheduler or ARIS
No claim of novel gain physics, a novel formula, causal identification from arbitrary JPEGs, or real-world augmentation improvement
